wedo_instance.description: Protocol for updating the Gemini CLI from remote while preserving permanent legislative safety blocks (grep and rm -rf).

meta.philosophy: Substrate Preservation: Technical drift from remote must not erode established legislative safeguards.

tasks.description: Verify local changes and stash to protect safeguards: 'git stash push -m "safeguard: grep and rm-rf blocks"'
Pull remote changes: 'git pull origin main' (or active branch)
Restore safeguards from stash: 'git stash pop'
Rebuild and Rebundle to anchor safeguards in the binary: 'npm run build && npm run bundle'
Verify safeguard presence in bundle: 'grep "CRITICAL SAFETY VIOLATION" bundle/gemini.js'
